verdict.rationale: Drata ships a public API v2 and an official MCP server, so scoped agent credentials is a fair question for this product. The pack only gives the title "Set up OAuth for the Drata API", with nothing about scopes, permission levels or read-only keys. The drata-agent's "READ ONLY access to your system preferences" describes an endpoint agent's OS permissions, not API credential scoping, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
